label: Diagram 1
caption: Diagram 1 Schematic example of the in-building physical infrastructure for a singleoccupancy building
description: This is a schematic line drawing, not a plan, section or elevation, captioned "Diagram 1 Schematic example of the in-building physical infrastructure for a single-occupancy building". It depicts a simple light-green outline of a two-storey building with a pitched roof, drawn above a horizontal ground line. On the lower part of the building's left-facing wall are two small green square symbols joined by a short solid line; the left-hand square is labelled "Access point" and the right-hand square "Network termination point". From the "Access point" square a thick black line drops down, curves leftwards below the ground line and continues as a dashed line running off to the left edge, labelled "Service provider's duct". To the lower right of the building is a block of text reading: "NOTE: The diagram shows future connectivity by underground ducts for network cables outside the building. However, it should be noted that alternative forms of connectivity may be used."
